purpose: Machine-readable log linking CoM publications to worlds, editorial angles, formats and Buffer IDs so performance can be learned over time.
rules: Every future autonomous CoM Instagram publication must append one entry after Buffer confirms creation.
Use the exact Buffer post ID returned by Buffer.
world_id must match data/com-content-map.json when the publication maps to an existing world; use brand-general only for umbrella-brand posts.
content_mode is one of news, evergreen, confluence-launch, archive-remix or brand.
asset_type is one of reel-video, image, carousel or other.
Never overwrite past entries; append new entries and preserve history.
